chapter_title_en: The Betrayal of a Trusted Face
chapter_seo_title: Dao Gui Yi Xian Chapter 392: A trusted friend turns enemy in a brutal twist.
chapter_meta_description: Li Huowang finds Zhuge Yuan, only to be betrayed. The Zuowandao's horror reaches a new peak as identity itself is swindled in this devastating chapter of Dao Gui Yi Xian.
og_title: Li Huowang's Greatest Ally Becomes His Executioner
og_description: A shocking betrayal reshapes everything. In the Dao-Twisted World, even a friend's face is just another lie waiting to be peeled away.
twitter_title: The Zuowandao's cruelest trick: stealing a friend's face.
twitter_description: Li Huowang finds salvation in Zhuge Yuan, only to be struck down by the very hands he trusted. Chapter 392 is a masterclass in betrayal.

lore_anchors.definition: A secret society of tricksters and liars; their name derives from a Daoist meditative concept ("sitting in forgetfulness") twisted into a philosophy of deception and chaos. They can swindle abstract concepts like abilities and identity.

A ritual writing implement used by the Judge of the Dead in Chinese mythology to determine a soul's fate in the afterlife; in the Dao-Twisted World, it can be used as a weapon to sever life and sensation.
A corrupt and self-destructive path to power within the novel's cultivation system, based on the idea of the lowly dung beetle. It requires the user to access extreme inner pain and sacrifice.
The corrupted counterpart to the Heart-Element; its ability allows it to hide or erase concepts, objects, and memories from reality.
An object left by Zhuge Yuan, revealed to be wrapped in hair from a Heart-Turbid; it serves as a medium for disguise and deception.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why didn't Zhuge Yuan attack the real Zuowandao?
cultural_notes_faq.a: The chapter's final twist reveals that the "Zhuge Yuan" who appeared was not a trick, but the real Zhuge Yuan who was secretly allied with the Zuowandao, making the betrayal genuine and complete.

It is a destructive, last-resort cultivation path in the Dao-Twisted World that requires the user to inflict extreme emotional and physical pain upon themselves for a massive, temporary power boost, which Li Huowang could not use due to time constraints.

cultural_notes_faq.q: What was in the black spindle?
cultural_notes_faq.a: The spindle was wrapped in the hair of a Heart-Turbid (心浊), a being with the power to hide or erase things from reality. The Zuowandao needed it to perfect its disguise as Li Huowang.
